title: Add 'beneficiary_residence_status' field to HKMA daily transaction reports
description: HKMA Circular B-2026-04 mandates a new beneficiary residence status field in the daily transaction reporting submission. Adds the field to the billing-api report generator and emits the new field into audit-log for traceability. No customer-facing changes.
diff:
diff --git a/billing-api/src/reporting/hkma_daily.py
@@ -45,7 +45,12 @@
 def build_report_row(txn):
     return {
         'transaction_id': txn.id,
         'amount_hkd': txn.amount_hkd,
+        'beneficiary_residence_status': resolve_residence_status(txn.beneficiary_id),
         'occurred_at': txn.occurred_at.isoformat(),
     }

diff --git a/billing-api/src/audit_emit.py
@@ -22,6 +22,7 @@
 def emit_hkma_report_generated(report_id, row_count):
     emit_audit_event('hkma.report.generated',
                       report_id=report_id,
+                      schema_version='2026-04',
                       row_count=row_count)
